doc.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The current quartet with Jason Moran, Reuben Rogers and Eric Harland
summary: Asked what the latest quartet means to him, Lloyd calls it the tippy-top so far and says he is proud of the young men.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah! I feel it. Ok, your latest group is on par with the very best groups of your career. You, Jason Moran, Reuben Rogers and Eric Harland are in the process of creating a very new language for the jazz quartet. As you think about your entire career, what does this ensemble mean to you?
It’s the tippy-top of the top, or most.
Alright. Boy that says a lot! Yeah, ok.
And these young men, I’m proud of them. They’re moving into the world and makin’ their own groups and communicators. But they seem to appreciate something from this place.
